_about: Pagouro BE Styles (D-103). One entry per style: the trigger token the LoRA is addressed with, the style phrase that follows it in every training caption and at inference, the one-line description the judge compares against, and the corpus folders under data/images/styles/.

rockart.name: Rock art of the American Southwest
rockart.phrase: ancient petroglyph rock art, figures pecked into dark desert stone
rockart.judge: looks like ancient Southwestern rock art: simplified figures and animals pecked or painted on rough rock, flat silhouettes, earth tones, no shading or perspective
rockart.note: Photographs of ancestral sites (Wikimedia Commons, per-file CC0 / public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA, each attributed in the ledger). The pack makes no claim to the cultures' meanings.

ukiyoe.name: Ukiyo-e woodblock print
ukiyoe.judge: looks like a Japanese woodblock print: flat colour areas, black outline, patterned fabrics, no Western shading or perspective

egyptian.name: Egyptian tomb painting
egyptian.judge: looks like an ancient Egyptian wall painting: figures in profile with frontal shoulders, flat registers, ochre, black, blue-green and white on a plaster-coloured ground

greekvase.name: Greek vase painting
greekvase.phrase: ancient Greek vase painting, black-figure or red-figure on terracotta
greekvase.judge: looks like Greek vase painting: black or red-orange figures on the opposite ground, silhouette profiles, incised detail, meander borders

naturalhistory.name: Natural-history plate
naturalhistory.judge: looks like a 19th-century natural-history plate: a single specimen drawn precisely, hand-coloured, on a plain pale ground, perhaps with a branch or a ground line

dutch.name: Dutch Golden Age painting
dutch.judge: looks like a 17th-century Dutch oil painting: naturalistic faces and hands, dark ground, warm directed light, fine fabric and still-life detail
dutch.note: The anatomy candidate: the corpus is full of real faces and hands.
